recommendations.description: Launch a joint UM and reimbursement policy audit for CA Medicaid authorized acute inpatient admissions in TANF Standard and ABD Non Dual, focused on Infectious and Parasitic Diseases with O.R. Procedures with MCC, Cellulitis without MCC, and Poisoning and Toxic Effects of Drugs without MCC, to verify prior-auth-to-claim matching, denial enforcement, provider-specific contract compliance, and site-of-care at UC Davis Medical Center and Santa Clara Valley Medical Center.
evidence: CA authorized acute hospital spend increased across TANF Standard and ABD Non Dual.
Infectious/parasitic procedures with MCC drove the largest inpatient pressure.
Admissions increased and paid per admit increased overall.
All major source cards show prior authorization required.
UC Davis Medical Center appears in infectious inpatient drill context.
Santa Clara Valley Medical Center appears in cellulitis inpatient drill context.

recommendations.description: Audit CA AUTH_CODE_DISTRIBUTION pa_required_code=Y acute hospital TANF Standard inpatient claims for Infectious and Parasitic Diseases with O.R. Procedures with MCC, Esophagitis, Gastroenteritis and Miscellaneous Digestive Disorders without MCC, and Cirrhosis and Alcoholic Hepatitis with CC to confirm prior authorization was obtained and matches actual claims, then correct and reprocess authorization status before denial enforcement or reimbursement changes.
evidence: A large share of the apparent CA increase sits in authorization code distribution.
All supporting evidence is flagged for authorization or mapping shift and validation before action.
This is a gating issue for both UM and reimbursement work.
peer_benchmarking: United Health: qualifying hepatic fibrosis tests separately reimbursed every 180 days; specified multianalyte assays not reimbursed.
Humana: no documented auth policy, appeals process, or reimbursement detail in supplied table.

recommendations.description: Initiate a targeted CA inpatient review of PA-required ER admissions at UC Davis Medical Center and Mercy San Juan Medical Center for sepsis, cirrhosis, cellulitis, and digestive diagnoses to confirm prior authorization, review UM ROI/P.A.V. opportunities, assess admission root causes, and perform program-integrity coding validation.
evidence: Sepsis unspecified organism added +$4.1M with 75 more admissions in CA.
E. coli sepsis added +$1.1M with 15 more admissions.
Alcohol-related and unspecified cirrhosis contributed about +$0.9M combined.
Cellulitis and digestive diagnoses added additional admission growth.
All highlighted stays were acute-hospital ER admits with prior authorization required.
Top providers included UC Davis Medical Center and Mercy San Juan Medical Center.
peer_benchmarking: United Health lists only hepatic fibrosis testing policy; no comparable inpatient DRG policy benchmark.

OTHER also increased within unclear facility categories.
PA-required claims include auth dimension present.

peer_benchmarking: United Health applies broad inpatient/outpatient facility charge policy, not DRG-specific.

recommendations.description: Initiate a claim-by-claim audit and focused clinical review for UNATTRIBUTED and IA/OH inpatient outliers, including CHILDRENS HOSPITAL tracheostomy ventilation and craniotomy admissions, UH PORTAGE ventilator cases, IOWA METHODIST stomach procedure cases, and unattributed pulmonary edema/respiratory failure admissions, to verify member attribution, DRG/diagnosis assignment, and contractual claims processing, then route validated catastrophic members to targeted clinical management.
evidence: One DC tracheostomy ventilation case at CHILDRENS HOSPITAL drove +$1.3M.
One DC craniotomy case at CHILDRENS HOSPITAL added +$668K.
UNATTRIBUTED rare-case spend concentrated across tracheostomy, craniotomy, trauma, pneumonia, and GI obstruction.
IA/OH low-volume procedure and ventilator cases added +$280K.
Pattern calls for diagnosis, DRG, and attribution confirmation at member level.

United Health lists Inclusive Charges; BCBS_IL, BCBS_TX, Fidelis, and Regence list Bundles.

recommendations.description: Complete an auth-to-claim validation and contractual claims-processing review for AUTH_CODE_DISTRIBUTION in AR and DC on pa_required_code Y inpatient claims, confirm authorization-denial enforcement and reimbursement mapping, and defer downstream operational reprioritization until classification is corrected.
evidence: AUTH_CODE_DISTRIBUTION is flagged as an auth_or_mapping_shift.

DC scope includes CHILDRENS HOSPITAL with pa_required_code Y.
AR scope includes ARKANSAS CHILDREN'S HOSPITAL with pa_required_code Y.

recommendations.description: Open a joint UM, claims, and network remediation review for TANF Standard acute hospital stays in TX Infectious and Parasitic Diseases with O.R. Procedures with MCC, MO cirrhosis and digestive admissions, and NC ECU HEALTH MEDICAL CENTER to confirm required prior authorization was obtained and matched to actual services, enforce mismatched authorization denials, review outlier reimbursement and itemized bills, and escalate provider contract or site-of-care remediation where costs remain outlying.
evidence: MO, NC, and TX TANF Standard acute hospital spend increased on authorized admissions.
TX Infectious and Parasitic Diseases with O.R. Procedures with MCC drove growth.
NC variance was concentrated at ECU HEALTH MEDICAL CENTER.
MO growth included cirrhosis and digestive admissions.
All key drivers were prior-authorized acute hospital admissions.
peer_benchmarking: Centene bundles routine institutional inpatient charges unless medically necessary.
United Health exempts Missouri, North Carolina, and Texas from UB-04 inpatient unbundling.

recommendations.description: Launch a CA repeat-admission CTI and care-navigation review for SEPSIS D/T METHICILLIN SUS STAPH, OTHER GRAM-NEGATIVE SEPSIS, CANNABIS HYPEREMESIS SYNDROME, POISN FENTANYL/FENT ANALOG ACC INIT, and cellulitis admissions, while auditing UC DAVIS MEDICAL CENTER and SANTA CLARA VALLEY MEDICAL CENTER for provider-specific contract and ED-to-inpatient site-of-care variance.

Methicillin-susceptible staph sepsis emerged at UC DAVIS MEDICAL CENTER.
Other gram-negative sepsis emerged at UC DAVIS MEDICAL CENTER.
Cannabis hyperemesis syndrome added +$211K on 30 more admissions.
Cellulitis right lower limb emerged at SANTA CLARA VALLEY MEDICAL CENTER.

Centene limits certain GI testing coverage to inpatient, ER, or observation.
